body.cost_method: average cost (holdings); FIFO parcels for tax
body.note:
A non-Chinese tungsten producer at the point where volumes double and the cash starts to show. 

Volumes have inflected: the September quarter's revenue alone is close to all of FY26. 

Strategic scarcity: China dominates supply, defence and semiconductor users want non-Chinese tonnes, and the Forrest stake adds credibility. The A$39m Mt Carbine crusher expansion (1 to 2 Mtpa) commissions in Q3 FY27, lifting volumes and lowering unit costs. Canaccord (A$0.55) and Morgans (A$0.52) both rate it Buy against a price of about A$0.335.
